Dispatch.title: Dispatch
Dispatch.body: Dispatch maintains the text blocks for outgoing messages, per language, and shows the log of everything sent. This surface changes no send behaviour: channels, recipients and confirmations stay with the documents that send. The log is append-only; a logged send can neither be edited nor deleted.
